fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner read the gate (internal/api/run_review.go runRunGate: a non-autonomous run proposes its plan's drafts and returns before any accept) and the Inbox (internal/api/inbox.go: accept items only for autonomous runs' gated proposals). It raised three questions to the arbiter: which intent the change set serves, which rule an owner-run gate accepts under when rhiza.autonomy.accept is auto, and whether that accept needs the plan's review to have passed. The arbiter's Decision owner-run-gate-auto-accept: serve milestone-25; accept under a new rule 'autonomy', allowed only while rhiza.autonomy.accept is auto, with 'autonomous' keeping its meaning; accept only after the review has passed by gateReview's check, else keep the proposals waiting as with accept owner. The planner wrote three leaves: the owner-run gate accepts under rule autonomy, rule autonomy itself, and the Inbox listing any run's gated proposals that still wait.
fields.title: Plan of Fix An owner-run plan's gate (autonomous, arbiter)
